source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Ιωάννης εκ Γεωργίας»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 1751)» and gives one sentence: bishop of the city of Manglisi in eastern Georgia, fallen asleep in peace in 1751. The calendar line calls him only «εκ Γεωργίας», of Georgia; the see comes from the body of the page and is what distinguishes him from the other Johns, which is why the display name carries it. It prints no hymn. A Georgian saint recorded here only from a Greek source.
